Definition
[Legendre transform] 1. ch3:3.3.2-def-1\group Calculus of Variations The Legendre transform of $L$ is \[ L^*(p)=\sup _{q\in \R ^n}\{ p\cdot q-L(q)\} . \]

The maximizing relation $p=DL(q)$ identifies this transform with the Hamiltonian; write $H=L^*$.
